issue_context.title: Improve the right-click context menu in the tags widget
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

The right click context menu for tag items currently only has shell items, we should add Open With, Open in new tab/window/pane, etc. when applicable.

### Requirements

- Add more items to right-click context menu in tags widget

### Files Version

2.4.40.0

### Windows Version

Windows 11 21H2

### Comments

_No response_
